question: Which of the following elements is a virulence factor of Bacillus anthracis?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Capsules -> help Bacillus anthracis evade the host immune system -> increase virulence -> 95% CHAIN: Endospores -> aid in survival and dissemination of Bacillus anthracis -> contribute to virulence -> 95%
enhanced_information: Capsules and endospores are virulence factors of Bacillus anthracis. Capsules help the bacterium evade the host immune system, increasing virulence. Endospores aid in survival and dissemination, contributing to virulence. The evidence path of spores causing infection in Bacillus anthracis supports the role of endospores in its virulence.
analysis: The core medical principle is that both capsules and endospores are virulence factors of Bacillus anthracis. Capsules help evade the host immune system, while endospores aid in survival and dissemination. The enhanced information confirms that both capsules and endospores contribute to the virulence of Bacillus anthracis.
